external_account_number.description: The account number in the source system. This, along with the import_supplier, will be used to find the account in Kraken.

import_supplier.description: The import supplier code that the account was imported on to. This, along with the external_account_number, will be used to find the account in Kraken.

x-enum-descriptions.ORIGIN_BUSINESS_NO_CONTRACT: Origin Business - No Contracts e.g. trustee

instruction_reference.description: The reference of the mandate as known by the vendor.

ledger_code.description: The code of the relevant Kraken ledger type for the payment instruction. This code must exist in Kraken.

x-validators.name: Validate ledger code
x-validators.description: Validates that the ledger code provided in the payload matches an available ledger type in Kraken.

reference.description: The reference of the mandate as known by the vendor.

type.description: The payment type of the payment instruction.

use_for_scheduled_payments.description: Whether this payment instruction should be used for scheduled payments on a given ledger. If true, this instruction will be set as the payment method for the account's payment schedule.

valid_from.description: The date from which the payment instruction is valid.

x-validators.name: Validate that account data is staged and account created
x-validators.description: Validate that an account exists for the external_account_number and import_supplier code. This means that the import data must already have been staged and processed into an account.

x-validators.name: Validate that migration is ongoing
x-validators.description: Validate whether or not an import supplier is open for further data migration.

x-validators.name: Validate that either ⁨instruction_reference⁩ or ⁨reference⁩ are provided
x-validators.description: Validate that exactly one of ⁨instruction_reference⁩ or ⁨reference⁩ is provided.
